note: Each mob's rules (world/mobs.ts, and the bot's web/town-mobs.ts; its art is manifest mobs.<id>). Frames are 0-based (the art READMEs count some from 1; these win). attackFrame = the attack anim's frame where the hit lands; charge = the Tire Roller's lunge frames (first, last); shadow = [w, h] art px of the ground shadow, centred on the anchor; floats = the sprite hangs above its anchor (the shadow stays on the ground there); variants = the looks, one picked per spawn (keep in step with manifest mobs.<id>.variants). The golem: attackFrame = Tire Slam, tossFrame = Scrap Toss's release, glareFrames = the Lamp Glare cone's first and last frame.
